summary.scope: Eight evidence-supported 2026 confirmations reviewed against the user and GraL catalogues. Existing duplicates and classifications retained; record count is not a completeness claim.
summary.images: Eight survey/archive columns independently searched; all eight paper images and high-resolution website images supplied. no means no usable image retrieved, not proof of no historical observation.

records.name: COOLJ1153B
records.note: COOLJ1153B is a distinct Type II background quasar at z=1.939 behind the same z=0.4301 cluster as COOLJ1153A (ID 355; z=1.524). Four images B1-B4; maximum separation 26.0 arcsec. Coordinates refer to B1.
records.candidate report: No separate earlier public candidate report established in this review.
records.confirmation report:
Solhaug et al. 2026 (preprint); Distinct Type II background QSO at z=1.939, same z=0.4301 cluster as A at z=1.524. FIRE spectrum and BPT AGN classification, multiple images and cluster lens model. Coordinates are image B1. Existing catalogue entry is A only.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13514
records.discovery review: 2026 confirmation report retained separately from earlier candidate selection. Astrometry: Solhaug et al. 2026 Table 1, B1.
